source: Team demo content from the gap analysis (B-7), based on NASA HRP 'Space radiation' and CSA radiation monitoring; not medical advice; needs flight-surgeon and radiation-officer review

questions.text: Is the radiation alarm still on?
Is anyone outside the shelter, or on a spacewalk?

answers.label: No, everyone is in the shelter

questions.text: Does anyone feel sick, or have they vomited?

summary.LOW: The radiation level is back to normal. Stay alert and keep records.
summary.MODERATE: Radiation is high. Everyone goes to the radiation shelter now.
summary.CRITICAL: Dangerous radiation. Shelter everyone now and alert the base.

LOW.text: Note who was outside, and how long.
Stay near the shelter for an hour.

MODERATE.text: Go to the radiation shelter now.
Stop all spacewalks and outside work.
Stay until the base says it is safe.

CRITICAL.text: Go to the radiation shelter now.
Bring anyone outside back in fast.
Stay until the base says it is safe.

callBaseWhen: Call the base at once if anyone feels sick or was outside during the alarm.
